MedDialogue-Audio
	

English Medical Dialogue Corpus for Speech Recognition Research.
This repository contains MedDialogue-Audio, an English audio corpus designed for research in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) in the healthcare domain.
The dataset was published in the proceedings of the 7th SBBD Dataset Showcase Workshop, and is available online at the following link: https://sol.sbc.org.br/index.php/dsw/article/view/37199
